Aisha Patel: Heads-up — ACME Retail onboarding stalled; usage flat for 7d, renewal in 42 days. Need a compact save plan: quick enablement + adoption sprint. Who can lead?
Maya Chen: I can take lead on enablement. Suggest 2x 30m sessions next week. Need example prompts + team access.
Diego Ramos: I'll run a quick config audit and check for errors. I saw a 429 spike last week. @CS Bot can you pull last 14d token usage and top endpoints?
CS Bot: ACME Retail — tokens/day (last 14d): [520, 510, 495, 480, 470, 460, 455, 450, 430, 420, 400, 395, 390, 385]; top endpoints: /chat, /embed, /rerank. Avg latency: 210ms. Notable errors: 429 spike on Feb 11.
Kofi Mensah: Proposed bridging playbook (short): 1) Emergency enablement call (owner: Maya) 2) Config audit + quick fixes (owner: Diego) 3) Deliver 3 tailored prompt templates + runbook 4) Two-week adoption check + incentive (owner: Kofi)
Aisha Patel: Add a fallback downgrade path if adoption doesn't recover before renewal — downgrade to 'standard' tier, preserve data, offer 15% credit for 3 months. Also ensure we capture feedback during sessions.
Maya Chen: I'll draft the session agenda and prompt templates. Draft agenda:
```
- 0-5m: intros & goals
- 5-20m: quick wins (prompt tweaks, routing, macros)
- 20-30m: action items, owners, next steps
```
Diego Ramos: Sharing quick config checklist and a toggle snippet to experiment with KV cache/batching. I'll probe infra and push a follow-up ticket. Example command to toggle local test flags:
`curl -X POST /v1/admin/toggle -d '{"kv_cache":true, "batching":false}'`
Aisha Patel: Owners confirmed: Maya (enablement), Diego (config audit), Kofi (renewal owner). Timeline: enablement call by Mar 3, config changes within 48h after call, check-in one week after.
Kofi Mensah: I'll draft the renewal comms and the downgrade offer. I'll capture NPS + qualitative feedback during the call and post notes here.
Maya Chen: Scheduling poll now — prefer Tue/Thu mornings. Sending calendar invite once poll closes.
Diego Ramos: Small experiment to run post-call: Q1) enable KV cache for low-latency on non-heavy routes; Q2) reduce max_tokens for utility endpoints. Expected: lower cost and fewer 429s.
Aisha Patel: Perfect. I'll create a Jira epic, tag owners, and link the call notes. Keep this thread updated with outcomes. :thumbsup:
